svg.text: Magic Wand pen: wiring and routing
Top: plan view into the bottom shell, top shell removed (parts drawn see-through, wires run beneath them). Bottom: schematic.
Nano 33 BLE Sense Rev2 (component side up)
Spektrum 800 mAh on edge (8 wide seen from above)
FPC ribbon above the power bay (dashed)
Pad order follows the classic Nano layout; check it against the silkscreen on your board before soldering.
FPC extension to DATA port (rear cap)
• FSR goes to 3V3, never 5V (nRF52840 pins max ≈ 3.6 V).
• Boost 5 V goes to VIN only. Check the VIN range
• SW1 sits after the charger, so the pen still charges
• Turn SW1 off while the DATA cable is plugged in,
so USB and the boost don't both power the board.
• Never connect the battery to the 3V3 pin.
Magic Wand pen, rev D sketch, 2026-11-10. All dimensions in mm. Not to scale when printed; use the numbers.
